items.text: At the PC: press Esc (or click the desktop) to shut the Windows clipboard panel at the bottom left; then in Marvelous, File, Quit, and No to saving. Then tap Done.
items.recommendation: Do it when you are next at the PC: about a minute. The panel keeps the game from coming to the front, so last night's walk never started and today's game runs wait on it. No web link: the answer is this page.

items.text: The corner at midweek, as the game you play draws it (three pictures below; tap one for full size). Still short of the Hook sheet: people in white base layers and stiff poses, plain brick without burnt headers, the quay end fading to white, simple trees on the hill, very deep dark between night lamps. Held back, being fixed: the view at Rita's (flat roof, plain phone-box side, even brick streaks) and Mickey's window (its street reflection has gone black). New: the brick no longer repeats and varies over each wall. Is the direction right?
items.recommendation: Keep going: each shortfall is a later step of the corner (trims, people, the far end). Not yet a 2026 frame, so this asks the direction, not a yes to the look. No web link: the answer is this page.
